prompt: For each month of 2025, a report needs Voltmarkt's net revenue and the net revenue of the same month of 2024, missing when that month of 2024 had no orders. Order dates are UTC days. Which query returns that, with the columns month, revenue_eur and revenue_prev_year_eur?

options.text:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with orders, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month with orders
  SELECT month, revenue_eur, LAG(revenue_eur, 12) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS revenue_prev_year_eur
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, revenue_eur, revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM compared
WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with orders, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur, p.revenue_eur AS revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM monthly m
JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with orders, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
)
SELECT m.month, m.revenue_eur, p.revenue_eur AS revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

  -- one row per month with orders, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM sales

)
SELECT month, revenue_eur, revenue_prev_year_eur
FROM compared
WHERE month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
